4094-7839-7926.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature or artifact.
Your commander is on the battlefield.
4094-7839-7926.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Slag Strider by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens due to Kaya, Geist Hunter.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2

2693-4693-5721-6664.easyPrerequisites: Land cards in your graveyard and under your control can tap to add at least {4}{G}{B}.
2693-4693-5721-6664.description:
Activate each untapped land you control by tapping it, adding mana.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it.
In response, activate Overgrown Estate repeatedly by sacrificing each land you control, gaining life each time.
Resolve the Aftermath Analyst ability, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate Phyrexian Reclamation by paying {1}{B} and 2 life, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G}.
Aftermath Analyst enters, triggering itself, causing you to mill three cards.

3967-4871-6705.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token due to Quina.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1753-3259-3968.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1753-3259-3968.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Grave Titan as attackers.
Grave Titan triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it
with two or more loyalty counters on it

539-2557-3301-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

360-3490-4050-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
360-3490-4050-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1482-2854-4574-6918.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1482-2854-4574-6918.description:
Cast Jeweled Lotus either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

431-851-4365-4772.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-851-4365-4772.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

2091-4560.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least nine tapped lands.
2091-4560.description:
Activate Soulfire Grand Master by paying {2}{U/R}{U/R}, causing you to put the next instant or sorcery card you cast from your hand this turn into your hand as it resolves.
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}, adding {R} for each tapped land opponents control and returning Mana Geyser to your hand.
Repeat.
2091-4560.notes: If opponents control ten or more tapped lands, this combo nets infinite red mana.

851-3470-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
851-3470-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
851-3470-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Lotus Cobra each trigger twice.
Resolve both Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

710-1052-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Danitha, adding one mana of any color.
When Danitha dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Repeat.

6023-6054.description:
Cast Gremlin Tamer by paying its mana cost.
When Gremlin Tamer enters the battlefield as an enchantment due to Secret Arcade, it triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature tokens enters the battlefield as an enchantment due to Secret Arcade, Gremlin Tamer's second ability triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat step 3.
6023-6054.notes: This combo creates a mandatory infinite loop at step 4 that will cause the game to end in a draw if it is not interacted with. It is highly recommended to only begin the combo if you have a way to break it.

686-914-1083.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least ten artifacts and/or enchantments.
686-914-1083.description:
Activate Cold Storage's first ability twice by paying {6}, exiling Archaeomender and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield.
Activate Cold Storage by sacrificing it, returning Dockside Extortionist and Archaeomender from exile to the battlefield.
When Dockside Extortionist and Archaeomender enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least ten Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Archaeomender trigger, returning Cold Storage from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate ten Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {10}.
Cast Cold Storage by paying {4}.
Repeat.
If opponents control eleven or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

1283-1409-2781.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Felidar Guardian.
1283-1409-2781.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Felidar Guardian by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Felidar Guardian.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use Chromatic Orrery's second ability instead to draw infinite cards.

141-2034-4013-5219.description:
Cast Cabaretti Charm by paying {R}{G}{W}.
Holding priority, activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Cabaretti Charm.
Resolve the copy of Cabaretti Charm, creating two 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing both Citizen tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

877-1127-4254.description:
Cast Blinking Spirit by paying {0}.
When Blinking Spirit enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1869-2792-3089-4875.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}.
"Wizard" chosen with Conspiracy.
1869-2792-3089-4875.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}.
Cast Great Whale by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it and Inalla trigger.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Great Whale.
When the Great Whale token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Barrin by paying {2} and sacrificing the Great Whale token, returning the nontoken Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

751-2564-4231.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Lonis.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating a Clue, a Food, and a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

339-1912-1995.notablePrerequisites:
Gauntlets of Light attached to Jegantha.
Jegantha does not have summoning sickness.
339-1912-1995.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Jegantha by paying {W}, untapping it.
Repeat.

254-1365-1402-4853.notablePrerequisites: Diamond Lion does not have summoning sickness.
254-1365-1402-4853.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls, giving Diamond Lion persist until end of turn.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, discarding your hand, and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Diamond Lion's persist ability and Dross Scorpion both trigger.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion ability, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Diamond Lion's persist ability, returning it from the graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Diamond Lion and giving Diamond Lion haste until end of turn.
Repeat.

1636-2370-4050-4649.notablePrerequisites: Tempting Licid does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2370-4050-4649.description:
Activate Tempting Licid by tapping it and paying {G}, attaching it to Bramble Elemental.
Bramble Elemental triggers, creating two Saproling creature tokens.
Intruder Alarm triggers twice.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing a Saproling creature token, adding {G} each time.
Pay {G} to end Tempting Licid's effect, making it a creture once more.
Resolve both Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

4120-4215-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Vigor.
Vigor dies, triggering itself and Verdant Succession.
Resolve the Vigor trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Vigor, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Vigor's power.
Repeat.
